task: [.github/workflows/codeql.yml] .github/workflows/codeql.yml dosyasındaki CodeQL tarama süresini düşürmek için pip ve paket kurulum adımlarına actions/cache entegre edilerek bağımlılıkların tekrar indirilmesi önlenmeli, yalnızca ilgili dosya değişikliklerinde çalışması için workflow tetikleyicilerine paths/paths-ignore filtreleri eklenmeli ve bağımsız test ile analiz adımları paralel job'lara bölünerek 65 saniyelik medyan çalışma süresi optimize edilmelidir.

evidence.detail: Workflow file identified for optimizing CodeQL scan duration, pip package caching, path filtering, and job parallelization.

factual_findings: .github/workflows/codeql.yml controls the CodeQL analysis workflow and currently has a median execution duration of approximately 65 seconds.
Dependency setup steps in .github/workflows/codeql.yml re-download Python/pip packages on every run due to missing dependency caching mechanisms.
Triggers under `on:` in .github/workflows/codeql.yml lack `paths` or `paths-ignore` filters, causing the workflow to run on commits that do not affect executable code.
hypotheses: Integrating `cache: 'pip'` or `actions/cache` in .github/workflows/codeql.yml will prevent redundant package downloads and decrease step execution time.
Adding `paths` and `paths-ignore` rules to `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` triggers will eliminate unnecessary workflow runs on non-code file changes.
Splitting independent setup, testing, and CodeQL matrix scanning steps into parallel jobs within .github/workflows/codeql.yml will reduce total workflow runtime below 65 seconds.
result.recommendation: Refactor `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` by adding dependency caching (`cache: 'pip'`), adding trigger path filters (`paths`/`paths-ignore`), and splitting independent execution steps into parallelized GitHub Actions jobs.
result.next_action: Apply the caching, path filtering, and parallel job changes to .github/workflows/codeql.yml and verify workflow runtime reduction.
